notes:
Tier 1 (direct HTTP) sufficient throughout; site is Shopify-hosted (confirmed via robots.txt comment). robots.txt checked first: no Claude/Anthropic/GPTBot-specific disallow, generic Disallow list only covers /admin,/cart,/checkout,/search etc; Sitemap directive present. Fetched sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml (1919 <loc> collection URLs) and grepped for holiday/festival keywords (noel/christmas, halloween, paques/easter, valentin/valentine, thanksgiving, nouvel-an/new-year/reveillon, diwali/hanoukka/epiphanie/chandeleur, citrouille/sorciere/fantome). Only Christmas (Noel) terms matched; no Halloween, Easter, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, New Year's, Diwali or Indian-festival collections exist anywhere in the sitemap. Also checked the live mega-menu (French locale) on the homepage HTML - no seasonal/Noel top-level nav entry is currently shown (off-season, early Sept), but the Christmas collections are still live (HTTP 200) and indexed, just unlinked from nav right now; this is normal end-of-season dormancy, not absence. Also found 'fete-des-meres' (Mother's Day) and 'fete-des-peres' (Father's Day) collections in the sitemap. CORRECTION (orchestrator verify pass, 2026-09-04): Mother's Day/Father's Day are in-scope per the rules module's seasonal-events vocabulary, so the worker's original 'out of project scope' rationale was wrong and its content was unverified at merge time. Verified content directly via /collections/<handle>/products.json: fete-des-meres = 114 products (books, jewelry, toiletries, home textiles - no coherent product type), fete-des-peres = 97 products (sweaters, sneakers, t-shirts, kitchenware, stationery - no coherent product type). Both are cross-category audience gift-guide curations spanning unrelated product types, matching the exact same site-specific pattern already correctly excluded above for noel-pour-elle/noel-pour-lui (audience-themed 'gift ideas for her/him' hubs, not genuine product-type categories) - so EXCLUDED, but for the verified content reason, not the original scope-based reason. Also found generic 'seasonal-color' collections (vert-dautomne, lete-chez-merci, selection-rentree, selection-printemps, etc.) which are excluded per the explicit rule against merely-seasonal colors/timing collections (no holiday tie).

For every noel-* / selection(-de)-noel-* collection candidate (31 total found), verified via Shopify's public /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 endpoint (paged until an empty page), which returns the exact, authoritative product count and product titles - far more reliable than scraping the rendered PLP text since this theme does not print a visible 'N produits' count on the page. For each candidate checked the <title>/<h1> and a sample of product titles to determine genuine Christmas association vs. reused generic collections or cross-category gift-guides:

INCLUDED (site itself brands the page as Noel/Christmas AND it is a coherent product-type category, not an audience/gift-guide curation):
- toute-la-selection-de-noel (593 products) = the umbrella 'shop all Christmas' hub; treated as the grouping/parent row (qty null) since it is the union of all Christmas-tagged items, several of which are gift-guide curations excluded below.
- selection-de-noel-tables-de-noel = 'Decoration Table de Noel' (Christmas tableware/table decor), 138 products, includes items explicitly tagged 'Edition Noel' (embroidered table runners/napkins).
- noel-decoration-de-sapin = 'Decoration pour sapin de Noel' (Christmas tree ornaments, string lights, garlands), 11 products.
- les-lumieres-de-noel = 'Lumieres de Noel' (Christmas string lights, lanterns, light reels), 15 products; overlaps ~10/15 with tree-decoration collection (both draw from the same lighting pool) - genuine sibling categories, not identical listings, so both kept per the no-double-count rule (which only forbids re-adding an identical listing or an exact parent=sum-of-children total).
- selection-noel-decoration = 'Decoration de Noel - Maison' (candles, home fragrance, ceramic matchboxes, general Christmas home decor), 47 products; fully contains the 11 tree-decoration items and 10/15 of the lights, confirming it is a broader home-decor umbrella, not an unrelated category.
- selection-de-noel-bougies = 'Bougie de Noel' (Christmas-edition candles), 69 products.
- noel-epicerie = "L'Epicerie de Noel" (Christmas food/grocery gifts - chocolates, teas, sauces, hot-chocolate mix), 14 products; a genuine site-defined product-type category for the holiday, kept despite being food rather than decor since the task scope is holiday categories broadly, not decor-only.

EXCLUDED as generic/reused collections whose slug happens to contain 'noel' but whose <title>/<h1> and product mix carry NO Christmas branding or seasonal product distinction (confirmed via products.json sampling): noel-vaisselle (title 'Vaisselle & Verrerie', products = plain flatware/spring-themed plates), noel-le-linge-de-maison (title 'Le linge de table', generic table linens), noel-jeux-jouets (title 'Jeux & Jouets', reused live as the 'Voir tout' link for the ordinary kids Games & Toys nav section), chaussettes-noel (title 'Selection Chaussettes', ordinary socks not stockings), noel-peluches (title 'Peluches', ordinary plush toys e.g. alpaca llama), noel-papeterie (title 'Papeterie', ordinary notebooks/stationery), noel-livres-pour-enfants (title 'Livres pour enfants', ordinary children's books), noel-livres-papeterie (title 'Livres & Papeterie', mostly non-Christmas stationery despite one Christmas sticker SKU - a normal category merely containing a few seasonal items, per the explicit boundary rule).

EXCLUDED as cross-category gift-guide / audience curations (technically Shopify collections with real grids, but function as marketing 'gift idea' hubs spanning many unrelated product types rather than a genuine product-type or decor category - matches the task's gift-guide exclusion): noel-pour-elle / noel-pour-lui ('Cadeaux de Noel pour elle/lui' - wallets, skincare, jackets, mixed), mode-femme-noel / mode-homme-noel ('Mode pour elle/lui Noel' - ordinary seasonal fashion, coats/sweaters, not Christmas-specific products), cadeaux-de-dernieres-minutes ('Cadeaux de dernieres minutes', no Noel branding, mixed), secret-santa ('Idees de Cadeaux Secret Santa', mixed candles/stationery/lanterns), idees-de-cadeaux-de-noel-les-coffrets (only 1 product, gift-box idea framing), selection-noel-bien-etre / selection-noel-livres / selection-de-noel-jeux / selection-de-noel-high-tech (all titled as 'Idee de cadeau <theme>' i.e. gift-idea-by-theme framing, not Noel-branded product categories), selection-de-noel-enfants ('Noel - L'univers enfant', 98 products sampled = ordinary toys/plush/games/stationery with no Christmas-specific items, a kids gift-guide, not a decor/product-type category), noel-plaid-coussin ('Un Noel Cosy' - sampled 50 products = mostly winter apparel: jackets, gloves, pyjamas, cashmere sweaters, slippers, mixed with some blankets/candles - a cross-category 'cosy season' gift guide, not a coherent Christmas product-type category despite the Noel-branded title).

All included links use https://www.merci-merci.com/collections/<handle>. Quantities are exact Shopify catalog counts from products.json (method: paginate limit=250 until an empty page, sum unique handles), i.e. QTY method priority tier 2 (structured API count), since the rendered PLP does not print a results total in this theme.
